title: WPSS/1052/2011 of GIRISH CHANDRA AWASTHI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No.1052 of 2011
Honíble Rajiv Sharma, J.
Mr. Kishore Kumar, Advocate,
holding brief of Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate
for the petitioner.
Mr. B.S. Parihar, Brief Holder for
the State.
Mr. B.D. Kandpal, Advocate for
respondent no.2.
Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate for
respondent no.4.
The petitioner participated in the
selection process pursuant to
advertisement dated 30.05.2009. The last
date for receipt of the applications was
30.06.2009. The petitioner has acquired
requisite essential educational
qualification only on 20.07.2009. The
petitioner though was permitted to
provisionally appear in the examination
but it transpires that he acquired the
requisite essential educational
qualification on 20.07.2009.
It is settled law by now that the
candidate should be eligible on the last
date of receipt of application as per the
advertisement or under the Rules.
Accordingly, there is no merit in
the writ petition and the same is hereby
dismissed.
(Rajiv Sharma, J.)
17.02.2018
Jitendra
